programmeSnapshot.classification: Partial exported provider charges; not a final invoice or exact remaining budget
programmeSnapshot.semantics: Gross is SUM(cost), excluding the separate SUM(credits.amount); the aggregate rounds to currency micros once. Net reconciles gross plus credits. These exported charges are measured rather than list-price arithmetic, but delayed or omitted export lines remain possible. Project-only totals exclude inference and control resources billed elsewhere. Do not release conservative programme reservations from this partial snapshot.
programmeSnapshot.querySql:
WITH scoped AS (
SELECT currency,cost,
IFNULL((SELECT SUM(c.amount) FROM UNNEST(credits) c),0) AS credit,
usage_start_time,usage_end_time,export_time,cost_type,
(SELECT l.value FROM UNNEST(labels) l WHERE l.key='papercusp-run' LIMIT 1) AS run_id
FROM `active-alcove-504205-q3.papercusp_billing.gcp_billing_export_v1_0113AC_50E9A0_8BB71D`
WHERE project.id='pc-agent-capacity-0930'
AND usage_start_time >= TIMESTAMP('2026-09-30T00:00:00Z')
AND usage_start_time < TIMESTAMP('2026-10-17T07:57:00Z')
AND (_PARTITIONTIME >= TIMESTAMP('2026-09-30T00:00:00Z') OR _PARTITIONTIME IS NULL)
)
SELECT currency,COUNT(*) AS row_count,MIN(usage_start_time) AS first_usage_start,
MAX(usage_end_time) AS last_usage_end,MAX(export_time) AS last_export,
CAST(ROUND(SUM(cost)*1000000) AS INT64) AS gross_micros,
CAST(ROUND(SUM(credit)*1000000) AS INT64) AS credit_micros,
CAST(ROUND(SUM(cost+credit)*1000000) AS INT64) AS net_micros,
COUNTIF(run_id LIKE 'p544%') AS p544_rows,
CAST(ROUND(SUM(IF(run_id LIKE 'p544%',cost,0))*1000000) AS INT64) AS p544_gross_micros,
COUNTIF(run_id IS NULL) AS unlabeled_rows,
CAST(ROUND(SUM(IF(run_id IS NULL,cost,0))*1000000) AS INT64) AS unlabeled_gross_micros
FROM scoped GROUP BY currency

p544LabelSnapshot.querySql:
WITH scoped AS (
SELECT currency,cost,IFNULL((SELECT SUM(c.amount) FROM UNNEST(credits) c),0) credit,
usage_start_time,usage_end_time,export_time,
service.description AS service,sku.description AS sku,
(SELECT l.value FROM UNNEST(labels) l WHERE l.key='papercusp-run' LIMIT 1) AS run_id
FROM `active-alcove-504205-q3.papercusp_billing.gcp_billing_export_v1_0113AC_50E9A0_8BB71D`
WHERE project.id='pc-agent-capacity-0930'
AND usage_start_time >= TIMESTAMP('2026-09-30T00:00:00Z')
AND usage_start_time < TIMESTAMP('2026-10-17T07:57:00Z')
AND (_PARTITIONTIME >= TIMESTAMP('2026-09-30T00:00:00Z') OR _PARTITIONTIME IS NULL)
)
SELECT run_id,service,currency,COUNT(*) AS row_count,
CAST(ROUND(SUM(cost)*1000000) AS INT64) gross_micros,
CAST(ROUND(SUM(credit)*1000000) AS INT64) credit_micros,
MIN(usage_start_time) first_usage_start,MAX(usage_end_time) last_usage_end
FROM scoped WHERE run_id LIKE 'p544%' GROUP BY run_id,service,currency ORDER BY run_id,service

readerFix.rootCause: billingQuery required usage_start_time>=runStart. GCP usage intervals can begin at the hour boundary before VM creation; their already-prorated, run-labelled charges were excluded.
readerFix.fix: Match usage intervals overlapping the requested half-open window: usage_end_time>start AND usage_start_time<end, preserving the immutable run-label predicate.
readerFix.detectorGap: Existing billing-reader tests returned preselected aggregate responses without executing the generated time predicate; none exercised a non-hour-aligned run start.
readerFix.recurrenceGuard: Eight maintained Vitest cases execute the generated temporal predicate in real node:sqlite against canonical ISO timestamps: leading partial hour, contained, enclosing, exact, adjacent-start/end and disjoint intervals. This exercises dialect-independent time predicates, not BigQuery arrays or full SQL semantics.
